text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Stop improvising! Do you know<n>how annoying
it is having to deal with<n>you messing up the
choreography?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, who cares? It looked cool, and<n>everyone had a
blast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After performing in the town's<n>holiday show,
Scarlet and Vodka get<n>invited to the big after-party.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: WHOOOOA! Look, they're doin' magic<n>tricks!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow, they even got thatorchestra! I've seen them on TVbefore, but it's amazing getting tohear them live!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking a look around, I see tabletop<n>games, lavish
decorations, and lively<n>events... Even Vodka and
Scarlet<n>have put aside their differences for<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Magician
text_block_list.text:
And when I remove the cloth...<n>What's this?! It's
the ball you were<n>just holding!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh? B-but how? I was holding it<n>just a second
ago! Vodka, did you<n>see what happened?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it just suddenly appeared under<n>the thing like
real magic! That was so<n>cool! Do it again, do it
again!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Vodka... I swear, you always act like<n>you're five.
Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come look! You can see the tree<n>outside from here.
Santa's out giving<n>presents to little kids.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Man, I remember sittin' on Mall<n>Santa's lap as a
kid. Heh. I got in<n>trouble for almost pullin' off his
fake<n>beard.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, of course you'd be the oneannoying Santa. Knowing you, I betyou kept yanking at his beard anyways.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-how'd you know that?! I... Idon't think I ever told you about itbefore... or did I?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: No, dummy. I just know what you're<n>like. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I regroup with Scarlet and Vodka, and<n>we head over
to the ritzy dinner<n>buffet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, I honestly thought they were<n>overexaggerating
to sound fancy, but<n>this is actually quite classy.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoooa, the food looks AWESOME! I<n>gotta grab a
plate!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Vodka, wait! You can't be serious!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, 'scuse me, pardon me,<n>comin' through!
...Hehe, I managed to<n>snag a whole mountain of
goodies!

text_block_list.name: Party Guest A
text_block_list.text:
Aw, look at her running around! A<n>growing girl's
gotta have her food,<n>huh? Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
A kid's gotta eat to replenish all that<n>energy.
Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh... R-right...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh my gosh, I am so sorry for herbehavior! I hope she didn't spoil themood...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: C'mon, Vodka, follow me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
W-why?! It's not like what I did was<n>a crime
against manners! Everyone<n>does it at Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's a school cafeteria, not a fancy<n>party. You're
supposed to get in line<n>and take modest portions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: So that's why the older folks were<n>laughin' at me...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. I dunno how these fancy<n>places work... I
didn't mean to<n>embarrass you two.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Y'know what, I think I'm kinda<n>outta place here,
so I'll just head out.<n>You guys enjoy the food!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: You're joking, right? I can't believe<n>you, you idiot!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What's the problem now?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I never said you were embarrassing<n>or out of place!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
It's just annoying having people<n>treat someone my
age like a little kid!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I mean, you're my rival! Let's showthem that we're not just kids runningaround.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Show them that you deserve to be<n>here, just like
it's a race!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, all right. If you're gonna put it<n>that way,
then it's on!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good. Now let's put our best foot<n>forward!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sure, I'm in! But uh, what should we<n>do first?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well... I think I might have an idea.

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's that kid again. I wonder<n>what she and
her little friend are up<n>to?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! Is everyone<n>enjoying the buffet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna rev the party up even<n>more with a
special performance for<n>you all!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet & Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy! "Our Blue Bird Days"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two put on an impromptu show.<n>They're
shockingly coordinated<n>despite the complete lack of
prep, and<n>the guests love it!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Good. Now let's put our best foot<n>forward!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Sure, I'm in! But uh, what should we<n>do first?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Well... I think I might have an idea.

text_block_list.name: Party Guest B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, there's that kid again. I wonder<n>what she and
her little friend are up<n>to?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Happy holidays! Is everyone<n>enjoying the buffet?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
We're gonna rev the party up even<n>more with a
special performance for<n>you all!

text_block_list.name: Scarlet & Vodka
text_block_list.text: Please enjoy! "Our Blue Bird Days"!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two give the impromptu show<n>everything
they've got. When they<n>wrap up, they both look
wiped.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good, now let's try this again. I'm<n>going to get in
line for the buffet, so<n>follow me and copy what I do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
First, you take just one plate. Then,<n>you go down
the buffet in order,<n>placing small portions neatly on
the<n>plate. And make sure you arrange<n>everything
nicely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... For a second there, I<n>would've believed
you were actually<n>some fancy-shmancy rich girl.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is that supposed to be a compliment<n>or not?! Ugh,
just take a plate and try<n>it yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet walks Vodka through the<n>proper etiquette
step by step. I notice<n>warm, approving nods from
the older<n>patrons around us, so it looks like the
operation's a success!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the party, Scarlet and Vodka<n>head back to
Tracen with confident,<n>satisfied smiles on their
faces.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Y'know... we should go to another<n>fancy party
some time! Seein' as I<n>know their game now.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Oh, you most certainly do not.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...But I guess you did okay-ish<n>enough that I could
maybe consider it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Good, now let's try this again. I'm<n>going to get in
line for the buffet, so<n>follow me and copy what I do.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
First, you take just one plate. Then,<n>you go down
the buffet in order,<n>placing small portions neatly on
the<n>plate. And make sure you arrange<n>everything
nicely.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... For a second there, I<n>would've believed
you were actually<n>some fancy-shmancy rich girl.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Is that supposed to be a compliment<n>or not?! Ugh,
just take a plate and try<n>it yourself, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet walks Vodka through the<n>proper etiquette
step by step. I notice<n>warm, approving nods from
the older<n>patrons around us, so it looks like<n>they're
doing okay.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But by the time they get back to<n>Tracen after the
party, they're both<n>exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Next time I go out with you, it's gotta<n>be
somewhere casual...
